research.title: NIST Guide to SI Chapter4 — prefixes
research.adopted: Exact decimal length prefixes and quantity-preserving unit conversion.
research.rejected: No binary kilo or shifting decimal point without unit reasoning.
research.usageRestrictions: Exact unit facts corroborated; no tables/text/images copied.
research.limitations: Scientific reference, not empirical teaching or Finnish curriculum evidence.

research.title: NIST SI Chapter5 — minute/hour
research.rejected: Do not apply metre-centimetre factor to time.
research.usageRestrictions: Definitions only, no reproduced source passages.
research.limitations: Linearly scaled length/time only; no temperature/area/composite units implied.

research.title: Converting units of length
research.adopted: Reason about larger/smaller unit and equal quantity before multiplication or division; physical ruler comparison optional.
research.rejected: Do not overload prerequisites or infer independent physical measurement from numerical answers.
research.usageRestrictions: Conceptual comparison; original wording/examples/figures. No source slides copied or blanket redistribution licence inferred.
research.limitations: UK Year5 comparator adapted to Finnish7–9 physics context; not an OPH prescription/efficacy result.

alignment.inherited: Known unit factors; direction/magnitude reasoning; same quantity in two units; comparisons require compatible units.
alignment.corrected: Only units of the same quantity convert. All units in a physics problem do not become identical. Exact rational arithmetic, explicitly reject unsupported/dimension-incompatible units; no decimal point/100time shortcut.
alignment.extended: Exploratory declared7units, paired same-quantity graphic, four new practice contexts including1min45s, equivalent numeric forms and honest right-quantity/wrong-requested-unit feedback.

planning.childGoal: Kirjoitan saman suureen laskun tarvitsemassa yksikössä.
planning.assumptions: Frozen QTY01 required; quantity-specific M-UNIT02/05 and decimal arithmetic acknowledged as Lite per-family assumptions. Give factor and explain operation, no additional hard graph gate.
planning.scope: Finite nonnegative exact length mm/cm/m/km and time s/min/h; input at most6integer+3decimal digits. No area/volume/affine/composite conversion.
planning.evidenceLimits: Guided conversion and fresh low-stakes requested-unit reports are not evidence of independent/delayed mastery or instrument competence. No personal history.
planning.sourceVsDesign: Frozen graph provenance inherited; no new OPH requirement or efficacy claim. Story, examples, exact model bounds, controls and pedagogical sequencing are project design.
planning.assetProvenance: Original deterministic SVG. User-supplied actual transparent Aava/Loikka PNG unchanged, named in lesson, no substitute character artwork or decorative motion.

extensions.executionLimits: Typed fixed unit dimensions; exact BigInt rational conversion/finite decimal or fraction display; arbitrary unsupported unit/kind rejected, no defaults. Exploration result disclosed only on reveal; editing model clears reveal, editing practice clears practice verdict. No timers/autoplay. Active instance owned per resolved lesson root; previous mount disposed. Current visible enum controls validated, input/change handled and check re-reads current premise; blank/unsupported does not silently become zero. New mount actively enables its own controls after previous instance disposal; synthetic and native regression retains original disabled-remount failure. Plain decimal digit bounds apply after harmless leading/trailing-zero normalization (raw input max128characters); only plain decimal numeric input is supported; exact fractional output is not fraction-input support. No rounding or scientific/expression eval. Static initial.svg derives from the same exact initial model state as mount; solved originalSVG retained separately in explanation. No-JavaScript fallback and live initial readout stay compatible.
